PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Mass, TWR per direction, lift range and hover time at real, heavy and full load. Cockpit key and live while building
PluginData.Description:
Will this ship lift when it is full? See it before you fly, and before you place the next block.
Panel, per ship: - Weight now, heavy (full of ore) and max (densest cargo), in kg. - Thrust to weight ratio bars for every direction at each load, matching sides grouped, with thruster effectiveness for the air where you are, and whether each direction is space capable. - Lift range on a 0g to 1.5g scale per load: green comfortable, yellow just, red can't. Marks the gravity you are in. - Hover time with a heavy load at 1 g: hydrogen and batteries now and when full.
Cockpit: press ] (right square bracket) in any cockpit, remote control or seat cycles full, collapsed, off. Building: hold a block and aim at a grid. Its mass, thrust in the direction it would push, symmetry copies and cargo volume are already counted. The same key while holding a block cycles full, collapsed, hidden.
Numbers come from the block and item definitions, so modded thrusters and items work. Reactors only count uranium, ammo boxes only ammo. Cargo mass follows the world's inventory multiplier the way the game counts it.
Settings: panel key, show while building, inventory size to plan for (0 = world), what-if thrust multiplier, panel size and position.
Works offline, hosted and on dedicated servers. Client-side only, no Harmony patches. Ships docked by connector are not counted, rotor, piston and hinge subgrids are. Known issues: while building, only cargo containers add volume before placing; tanks and batteries in hand count once placed.
Docs and bug reports: https://github.com/Po11arr/PolarsThrustPreview
